productions.title: Appropriate
productions.author: Branden Jacobs-Jenkins
productions.synopsis_short: When the Lafayette siblings return to their late father’s crumbling Arkansas estate to settle his debts, they uncover a hidden photo album containing horrific historical artifacts.
productions.synopsis_full: When the Lafayette siblings return to their late father’s crumbling Arkansas estate to settle his debts, they uncover a hidden photo album containing horrific historical artifacts. As long-buried rivalries ignite and secrets leak out, the family is forced to confront their shared history and implicit complicity in a dark past.

reviews.quote: A razor-sharp, fiercely funny, and devastating interrogation of American history.
